## Pirate Hunter

Before he met Luffy, Zoro was the most feared pirate hunter in the East Blue. Johnny and Yosaku still tell the stories.

Become a Bounty Hunter and defeat ten pirates.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Join the Bounty Hunters](f_bounty_hunters.md#q-3fb374008f6c9cc6)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 10 pirates

**Rewards**

- Doriki +150, Belly +6,000

## The Morning Paper

The News Coo drops the paper and the latest posters every morning. Read both.

Carry three wanted posters.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Pirate Hunter](f_bounty_hunters.md#q-4ccc41b2a23309d8)

**Tasks**

- Carry 3 wanted posters

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000

## Head Hunting

Grunts are worth pocket change. Captains are worth a season.

Defeat five pirate captains and belong to a crew. Crews are open to every faction.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Morning Paper](f_bounty_hunters.md#q-6974f8cefc092074)

**Tasks**

- Belong to a crew (/crew create &lt;name&gt;, or accept an invite)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500

## Cat Burglar

Nami robbed pirates for eight years to buy back her village. Money matters.

Collect a total of 100,000 Belly over your career.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Head Hunting](f_bounty_hunters.md#q-4c0de9b2a2f0dd79)

**Tasks**

- Collect 100,000 Belly in total

**Rewards**

- Doriki +300, Belly +8,500

## A Price Worth Collecting

Posters of other players are worth far more than any NPC.

Defeat two pirate players with a bounty of at least 5,000,000.

**Tasks**

Defeat thirty pirates on the Sabaody Archipelago.

Defeat three notorious pirate captains.

## New World Head Hunter

In the New World the prey hunts back.

Defeat three players with a bounty of at least 30,000,000 while you are in the New World, and hold an island for your crew.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Notorious Marks](f_bounty_hunters.md#q-7dce0afcd7b5a320)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 3 players with a bounty of 30,000,000+ in the New World
- Own 1 island at once (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +90,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

## The Greatest Hunter

A hunter who brings in an Emperor never has to work again.

Collect 10,000,000 Belly over your career and defeat a player with a bounty of at least 100,000,000.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [New World Head Hunter](f_bounty_hunters.md#q-51a827a30a003923)

**Tasks**

- Collect 10,000,000 Belly in total
- Defeat a player with a bounty of 100,000,000+

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +250,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style), Golden Box
